query: select coalesce(sum(s.amount_cents), 0)::bigint as "cents!", coalesce(sum(s.tokens), 0)::bigint as "tokens!" from spend s join sessions n on n.organization_id = s.organization_id and n.id = s.session_id where s.organization_id = $1 and n.project_id = $2 and s.occurred_at >= to_timestamp($3::bigint / 1000.0) and s.occurred_at < to_timestamp($4::bigint / 1000.0)
